text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  rustfmt:
    name: Rustfmt
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test
```
